title: Relative clauses — Nominativ and Akkusativ
description: Learn about Relative clauses — Nominativ and Akkusativ in German.
explanation: Relative clauses give more information about a noun. The relative pronoun normally matches the gender and number of the noun, but the case depends on its function in the subclause.

examples.german: Der Mann, der dort steht, ist mein Onkel.
examples.english: The man who is standing there is my uncle.

exercises.question: Die Frau, ___ ich das Buch gebe, ist nett.
exercises.explanation: Dativ feminine relative pronoun is der (because of gebe).
